data.held_out_component: mechanism operating-point calibration only; the fixed base scorer is not an outer-fold OOF identity

decision.reason: No non-control mechanism passed both family budgets and the preregistered correct-edge retention floor.

per_video_tail_rank.transductive_rule: candidate score must exceed every sampled background score in its video

preregistration.kill_line: projected held background FP exceeds the CG0 family rate, or known-correct retention is below 0.20 in either family
